findings.detail: AMR GP Limited has a raw schedule interest rate of 10.50%, including 5.25% PIK, but the extracted holding has blank interest_rate.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate rate-fill flag. The raw filing schedule is readable and carries Interest Rate columns; totals tie to the filing's total investment portfolio, so this is not source_unavailable. A sampled flagged missing-rate position, AMR GP Limited, has blank interest_rate in the extracted holdings slice but the raw source row shows 10.50% in the interest-rate column. That proves at least one rate-fill violation is a real extraction gap rather than a false alarm.
